heading: Thursday, October 30, 2025
topLine: 2 model releases: MiniMax Speech 2.6 and Moonshot AI Kimi Linear.

items.headline: MiniMax releases Speech 2.6 for voice agents
items.summary: Speech 2.6 is a text-to-speech model aimed at real-time voice agents, with end-to-end latency under 250 milliseconds, direct reading of URLs, dates and amounts, and a Fluent LoRA voice-cloning feature covering 40+ languages.

items.headline: Moonshot AI open-sources Kimi Linear hybrid-attention model
items.summary: Kimi Linear is a 48B-total, 3B-active model built on Kimi Delta Attention (KDA), a linear-attention variant interleaved with MLA layers. Moonshot reports up to 75% lower KV-cache use and up to 6x decoding throughput at 1M-token context, and released the KDA kernel, vLLM support and base and instruct checkpoints.
